safety.title: 1.1 On-Site Safety
paragraphs: CrewVerse is committed to promoting a safe and professional working environment for all personnel deployed at events, productions, promotional activities, and other assignments.

The client, event organiser, production company, venue operator, and other responsible parties shall ensure that the event or work location is reasonably safe and complies with applicable safety requirements.
The client or responsible organiser shall, as applicable:

- Provide a safe working environment and adequate access to the designated work areas.
- Arrange appropriate safety equipment, emergency exits, first-aid facilities, and emergency response measures.
- Inform CrewVerse in advance of any known hazards, special safety requirements, or potentially dangerous working conditions.
- Obtain the necessary permissions, licences, and approvals for the event or production.
- Ensure that appropriate crowd control, fire safety, electrical safety, and security arrangements are in place wherever required.
CrewVerse personnel must follow reasonable on-site safety instructions and report unsafe conditions to the designated supervisor or event organiser.

CrewVerse reserves the right to withdraw, replace, or suspend the deployment of personnel where there is a reasonable concern regarding safety, unlawful activity, harassment, or a serious breach of agreed working conditions.
No provision of this clause shall require any person to continue working in circumstances involving an imminent and serious risk to their health or safety.

safety.title: 1.2 Liability
paragraphs: Each party shall be responsible for its own acts, omissions, negligence, misconduct, and breaches of applicable law or contractual obligations.

CrewVerse shall exercise reasonable care in coordinating and deploying personnel in accordance with the agreed scope of services. However, CrewVerse does not guarantee uninterrupted event operations or accept automatic responsibility for the acts or omissions of clients, venue operators, third-party vendors, audience members, or other independent parties.

CrewVerse shall not be responsible for losses arising from circumstances beyond its reasonable control, except to the extent that such losses result from CrewVerse's own negligence, wilful misconduct, breach of contract, or other liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.
Nothing in these Terms & Conditions excludes or limits liability where such exclusion or limitation is prohibited by applicable law.

safety.title: 1.3 Indemnity
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by applicable law, the client shall indemnify and hold harmless CrewVerse, its owners, employees, and authorised representatives against third-party claims, damages, liabilities, and reasonable legal expenses arising from:

- Unsafe site conditions or inadequate safety arrangements under the client's or venue operator's control.
- The client's negligence, wilful misconduct, unlawful acts, or breach of contractual obligations.
- Failure to obtain required event permissions, licences, or statutory approvals.
- Personal injury, property damage, or other losses caused by the client's acts or omissions or those of parties under the client's control.
This indemnity shall apply only to the extent that the relevant claim or loss is attributable to the circumstances described above.

CrewVerse shall similarly be responsible, to the extent required by applicable law and the relevant agreement, for losses attributable to its own negligence, wilful misconduct, or breach of contractual obligations.

Neither party shall be required to indemnify the other for losses caused by the other party's own negligence or wilful misconduct, except where otherwise permitted by applicable law and expressly agreed in writing.

safety.title: 1.4 Incident Reporting
paragraphs: Any accident, injury, property damage, harassment complaint, or other significant safety incident involving deployed personnel must be reported promptly to the designated representatives of CrewVerse and the client.
Both parties shall reasonably cooperate in documenting and addressing the incident and complying with any applicable reporting requirements.

payment.title: 2.1 Booking Confirmation
paragraphs: All bookings are subject to confirmation by CrewVerse, availability of the required personnel, and acceptance of the agreed service terms.
CrewVerse may require an advance payment or booking deposit before confirming personnel deployment.
The applicable advance amount, payment schedule, and outstanding balance shall be communicated to the client in the quotation, invoice, booking confirmation, or written agreement.

payment.title: 2.2 Payment Schedule
paragraphs: Unless otherwise agreed in writing:

- The client shall pay the advance amount specified in the quotation or booking confirmation to secure the booking.
- The remaining balance shall be paid according to the payment schedule expressly agreed by both parties.
- For recurring assignments, productions, or long-term staffing arrangements, payment milestones may be agreed separately in writing.

CrewVerse reserves the right to withhold deployment or suspend further services if the client fails to make a payment when due, subject to applicable law and reasonable prior notice where appropriate.

payment.title: 2.3 Additional Charges
paragraphs: Additional charges may apply to services or requirements that fall outside the original booking, including:

- Overtime or extended working hours.
- Additional personnel requested by the client.
- Last-minute changes to staffing requirements.
- Additional travel, accommodation, food, or transportation expenses where applicable.
- Special equipment, costumes, uniforms, or other agreed operational expenses.
Such charges shall be communicated to the client and, wherever reasonably practicable, approved in writing before the additional services or expenses are incurred.

payment.title: 2.4 Delayed Payments
paragraphs: If a payment is delayed beyond the agreed due date, CrewVerse may issue a payment reminder and request settlement within a reasonable period.
Any late-payment interest or administrative charges shall apply only where expressly agreed in writing and permitted by applicable law.
CrewVerse reserves the right to suspend future bookings or services for overdue accounts, subject to applicable contractual obligations and law.

payment.title: 2.5 Taxes and Invoicing
paragraphs: All prices, taxes, and applicable statutory charges shall be specified in the relevant quotation or invoice.

GST and other applicable taxes shall be charged in accordance with Indian law. The client shall provide any billing details, purchase orders, or tax-related information reasonably required for invoicing.

payment.title: 2.6 Payment Confirmation
paragraphs: A booking shall not be considered fully secured until CrewVerse has received the required advance payment and issued confirmation, unless an alternative arrangement has been expressly agreed in writing.

cancellation.title: 3.1 Cancellation by the Client
paragraphs: Any cancellation must be communicated to CrewVerse in writing through an authorised communication channel.
Any applicable cancellation charges, deductions for non-recoverable expenses and refund arrangements shall be disclosed and agreed in writing before the booking is confirmed.
Where a fixed cancellation fee or non-refundable booking deposit applies, it must be clearly disclosed and agreed upon before the booking is confirmed.

cancellation.title: 3.2 Cancellation by CrewVerse
paragraphs: If CrewVerse is unable to fulfil a confirmed booking, it shall notify the client as soon as reasonably practicable.
Where feasible, CrewVerse may offer suitable replacement personnel or an alternative arrangement, subject to the client's agreement.

If CrewVerse cannot provide the agreed services and no mutually acceptable alternative is arranged, payments received for the undelivered portion of the services shall be refunded, subject to applicable law and the terms of the booking agreement.

cancellation.title: 3.3 Postponement and Rescheduling
paragraphs: Requests to postpone or reschedule an event must be communicated to CrewVerse in writing.
Rescheduling shall be subject to personnel availability, vendor commitments, and mutual written agreement.

Any additional costs arising from the change, including revised transportation, accommodation, personnel, or third-party expenses, may be charged to the client after the revised costs have been communicated and agreed upon.
Payments already received may be adjusted against the rescheduled booking where both parties agree in writing.

cancellation.title: 3.4 Force Majeure
paragraphs: Neither party shall be held responsible for a failure or delay in performing its contractual obligations to the extent directly caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, severe weather, government restrictions, civil disturbances, public emergencies, or other qualifying force majeure events.
The affected party shall notify the other party as soon as reasonably practicable and both parties shall make reasonable efforts to minimise the impact.

Where an event is cancelled or postponed due to a qualifying force majeure event, the parties shall discuss rescheduling, adjustment of payments, or refunds in good faith, taking into account services already performed, reasonable non-recoverable costs, applicable law, and the terms of the booking agreement.

cancellation.title: 3.5 Refund Processing
paragraphs: Approved refunds shall be processed using the original payment method wherever reasonably practicable, unless another method is mutually agreed upon.
CrewVerse shall communicate the expected refund processing period when confirming the refund. Actual processing times may depend on the payment provider or banking institution.
Any deductions shall be consistent with the agreed booking terms and applicable law.

terms.title: 4.1 Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By requesting, confirming, or purchasing services from CrewVerse, the client acknowledges that these Terms & Conditions apply to the relevant booking, subject to any separate written agreement.
Any booking-specific terms expressly agreed in writing shall prevail over these general terms to the extent of any inconsistency.

terms.title: 4.2 Amendments
paragraphs: CrewVerse may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. The applicable terms for a confirmed booking shall be determined by the version agreed upon at the time of booking, unless the parties subsequently agree otherwise in writing or an applicable legal requirement necessitates a change.

terms.title: 4.3 Governing Law
paragraphs: These Terms & Conditions shall be governed by the laws of India.
Subject to applicable law, disputes arising from these terms shall be referred to the competent courts having jurisdiction over the relevant dispute and parties.
